notes.title: Gunslinger on Spring Sale!
notes.notes:
Hey! Small update to say we're on a 20% sale during Spring Sale along with some QoL changes.

[list]
[*]Fixed Ready button not showing up when on top of wagons.
[*]Fixed Shop not refreshing.
[*]Fixed Gun Sprites incorrectly showing on Shop.
[*]Added a confirmation section when restarting the run.
[*]Fixed alignment issues with Options and Main Menu.
[/list]

We're also finishing controller support and rebinding controls this week!

I've been away from the project for the past 2 months as work took most of my time, however I'm back to polish the game a bit more as well as add new content (upgrades, weapons, etc.). Took longer than I wanted to add both controller support and rebinding controls, but you can expect them rolling in during the weekend. Hope you have a good time with Gunslinger Express!

- Glinnor

notes.title: Gunslinger Express Launch!
notes.notes:
Hi! I'm so glad for the support we've been having from you guys in the past 24 hours, because of you we managed to catch so many bugs, balance enemies/guns and overall polish the game a bit more.

So far, we've released 19 hotfixes and to celebrate this new version of the game, we're adding the sniper rifle and 2 new regions available now! Forest and Snow Forest biomes are the first of many regions we want to add to the game over time, we're also working on new guns and enemies coming in the next 24 hours, I hope you enjoy!

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Added new Forest region.
[*] Added new Snow Forest region.
[*] Added sniper rifle.
[*] Added new SFX to guns and enemies.
[*] FIxed a bug where old UI would show up on locomotive.
[*] Fixed a bug where wagon selection was possible before the start of the run.
[*] Fixed destructables animation when shooting them.
[*] Fixed game over screen not showing up.
[*] Fixed game over screen being skippable.
[*] Fixed SFX and music bars in options menu.
[*] Fixed "wave cleared" triggering twice sometimes.
[*] Fixed menu animation.
[*] Fixed region transitions.
[/list]

notes.title: Gunslinger Demo is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey guys![/b]

We just released a new demo for Gunslinger Express, including the basic gameplay loop created in the past 2 weeks. This is the same demo included in the Next Fest but with some QoL changes made from players' feedback during the event.

On Next Fest, we doubled the amount of wishlists for the game and got over 110 players for the first time! Thank you for the awesome reception the game has been having, as you may know this is our first indie title from 2 creators working full-time on other things, this has been our side project for a few weeks and we already achieved quite a lot in that small time frame.

Our current goals for the release on December 6th are:
[list]
[*] 25 upgrades (from the 5 currently in the game)
[*] 5 wagon types
[*] 3 bosses
[*] 3 biomes
[*] 8 enemy types (from the 2 currently in the game)
[/list]

We hope that this will provide a sizeable experience to everyone, with great replayability while we work on future updates until the end of the year! We'll see you soon!
